Subject: RFP: Control mapping + evidence request (ProcureCorp)

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. ProcureCorp is moving your RFP to the security review stage. Our buyers asked for a control mapping for SOC 2 and ISO 27001 (we use the SIG format for initial review) and an index of artifacts you can provide for each control. The RFQ PDF is attached — we need an initial mapping and a plan for delivering supporting artifacts by April 8.

Specifically can you confirm:
- A mapping table that shows Redwood controls -> SOC 2/ISO controls/SIG rows
- Which artifacts (logs, configs, diagrams, policies) you can share as PDFs or links
- Your expected timeline for delivering artifact buckets and any constraints (e.g., redaction, NDA-dependent items)

If you prefer a quick sync, Elena and our security lead are available tomorrow afternoon.

Attached: ProcureCorp_RFP_2027.pdf

Best,

1) Deliver by April 5: a SIG control mapping CSV that lists Redwood control, SOC 2 / ISO 27001 equivalents, and the primary artifact type we will provide (policy, diagram, log extract, configuration snapshot).
2) Deliver by April 8: an evidence bundle (PDFs + links) for the priority controls you flagged in the RFP — access controlled via a shared Drive folder.
3) Exceptions: items requiring customer-specific redaction or covered by vendor NDAs will be flagged; we'll provide sanitized summaries where full artifacts can't be shared.

Attachments I will include in the first drop: Redwood_SOC2_System_Description_v3.pdf, network-diagram-2027.png, and an initial evidence-index-ProcureCorp.csv.

If that timeline works, I will assign Marissa and Karthik to lead artifact assembly and Ben to run the log exports and timeline for snapshots. We can also schedule a 30-minute clarifying call — suggest Fri Apr 2 at 2:00pm PT.

Priya — thanks for the plan. A couple of clarifying questions before we review the mapping: 

1) Retention windows: For request and audit logs, please state the retention period (e.g., 90 days, 1 year) and whether backups/archival copies are governed by the same retention.
2) Encryption scope: Confirm if backup snapshots are encrypted with the same keys (KMS) as production volumes and whether snapshot exports include any unencrypted artifacts.
3) Privileged access: For SOC 2 control CC6/ISO A.9 equivalence, can you provide a recent privileged access review or the cadence (quarterly/yearly) at which privileged accounts are reviewed?

If you could inline those answers in your mapping CSV (or as a short appendix) it will speed our review.

Thanks,
ProcureCorp Security Team
security@procurecorp.com

Elena / ProcureCorp Security —

Thanks for the patience. Deliverables uploaded to a shared, access-controlled Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cProcureCorpEvidence

What we provided (files are in the folder):
- evidence-index-ProcureCorp.csv (SIG mapping + artifact type + localization notes)
- Redwood_SOC2_System_Description_v3.pdf (system description, org chart, control ownership table)
- network-diagram-2027.png (infrastructure diagram, redacted IPs)
- auth-log-sample.csv (sanitized extract showing authentication events; retention window noted below)
- backup-manifest-202703.csv (snapshot manifest; encryption noted)

Quick answers to the security questions you flagged:
- Retention windows: authentication logs retained for 1 year in hot storage, then archived to encrypted cold storage for 5 years. Backup snapshots retained for 90 days in primary storage and retained as encrypted archives for 3 years.
- Encryption scope: all production volumes and snapshots are encrypted using our KMS (AWS KMS) keys with customer-sequestered CMKs available for Dedicated customers; exported snapshots are encrypted and we do not produce unencrypted exports.
- Privileged access review: privileged accounts are reviewed quarterly; the most recent review summary (Q1 2027) is included as an appendix in the system description PDF.

Notes/constraints: several internal forensic artifacts and raw stack traces are covered by vendor confidentiality; where necessary we provided redacted extracts and a control-level attestation describing the underlying evidence. If ProcureCorp needs a live walkthrough we can schedule a technical review with Karthik and Marissa (30–45 minutes).

If you need anything further to satisfy the RFP checklist, please let me know and we will expedite.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
